description: Christ-centered outdoor adventure program featuring camping, hiking, archery, rifle shooting, rope work, and biblical character development. Located near Ricketts Glen State Park!

meetings: Mondays at 6:30 PM (Sep-May main program, Navigators & Adventurers year-round)
description: Comprehensive program for boys ages 5-17 including archery, knot tying, woods tools, firebuilding, cooking, hiking, orienteering, wilderness survival, canoeing, and more. Programs divided by age groups from Foxes (5-6) through Adventurers (14-17).
Faith-based outdoor adventure program building boys into godly men through character development, outdoor skills, and leadership training in the heart of Pennsylvania.
